== Format ==
* '''Participants'''
** Two teams from the Upper Division of [[Dota Pro Circuit/2021/1/Southeast Asia/Upper Division|Season 1]]
** Four teams from the Lower Division of [[Dota Pro Circuit/2021/1/Southeast Asia/Lower Division|Season 1]]
** Two teams from open qualifiers
* '''Standings'''
** Single round-robin
** All matches are {{abbr/Bo3}}
** {{bgctext|up|Top two teams}} are qualified to [[Dota Pro Circuit/2021-22/1/Southeast Asia/Division I|Division I]] for the first tour of the next DPC season
** {{bgctext|down|Bottom two teams}} are eliminated
** {{bgctext|stay|Remaining teams}} remain in [[Dota Pro Circuit/2021-22/1/Southeast Asia/Division II|current division]] for the first tour of the next DPC season
** <span class="mw-customtoggle-Tiebreaker" style="border-bottom:1px dotted;">''Click here for tiebreaker rules''</span>
<div class="toccolours mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" id="mw-customcollapsible-Tiebreaker" style="width:760px; margin-left:45px">
*If there is a tie along the dividing line, tiebreaker match will be played
**{{bgctext|up|Upper Division}}/{{bgctext|stay|remain}}
**{{bgctext|stay|remain}}/{{bgctext|down|elimination}}
*** Two-teams tie: {{Abbr/Bo3}}
*** Three-teams or more tie: {{Abbr/Bo1}}
*For other ties (in order of importance):
*# Head-to-head result between the tied teams
*# Results against lower seeded team
*# If a tie can be broken along the way, the process is restarted
*# Coin toss
</div>
